name: Oliver García
tagline: Connecting Odoo to the rest of the world, one module at a time.

featured.text: Links Shopify stores to Odoo: products, stock, customers, orders, refunds and fulfilment over the GraphQL Admin API. Migrated the connector and its accounting, POS and eCommerce modules to Odoo 18, added Shopify Dev Dashboard authentication and made token renewal safe under concurrency.
mail_message_import: one inbox for what a company receives on any channel, with email and WhatsApp channels. Plus a fix to the mail_gateway webhook cache.
business_requirement_deliverable_project: when a requirement is approved, its deliverables become project tasks.
